capabilities: Encrypt and decrypt Markdown, Canvas, and Excalidraw files vault-wide, per folder, or per file
Lock and unlock the vault with a master password and optional recovery code
Auto-lock after inactivity or when the Obsidian window loses focus
Lock instantly and close protected notes with a panic-button hotkey
Repair and recover double-encrypted or corrupted files, including via an external Python script
extras: Includes an external Python recovery script that runs independently of Obsidian and supports current and legacy encrypted file formats. Master passwords do not sync between devices; each device must be set up separately (see SYNCING.md). README claims near-zero file corruption via re-engineered encryption state management.
intentEvidence: This is an enhanced fork of obsidian-protected-note focused on reliability, recovery, and a seamless user experience.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain-text files on disk, so sensitive notes are readable by anyone with file access and there is no built-in way to encrypt them.

relations.evidence: This is an enhanced fork of obsidian-protected-note focused on reliability, recovery, and a seamless user experience.
